prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 多列数值 · 8 列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Measured content facts (text px at 13px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "日期" · longest unbreakable unit 38px · widest one-line content 77px
  col 2: header "开盘" · longest unbreakable unit 34px · widest one-line content 34px
  col 3: header "最高" · longest unbreakable unit 34px · widest one-line content 34px
  col 4: header "最低" · longest unbreakable unit 34px · widest one-line content 34px
  col 5: header "收盘" · longest unbreakable unit 34px · widest one-line content 34px
  col 6: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable unit 48px · widest one-line content 48px
  col 7: header "成交量（手）" · longest unbreakable unit 61px · widest one-line content 80px
  col 8: header "成交额（万元）" · longest unbreakable unit 69px · widest one-line content 93px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 607px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 607px wide (column widths sum to at most 606px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 607px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"按交易日期呈现每日价格、涨跌幅和交易规模，供读者查阅与比较。","tasks":["按日期定位某个交易日，读取该日的价格、涨跌幅和成交情况。","纵向比较不同日期的开盘、最高、最低和收盘价，以及涨跌幅、成交量和成交额。","横向阅读同一日期的价格变化和交易规模。"],"relations":["每行是一日完整的交易记录，日期是定位该行的线索。","开盘、最高、最低、收盘是同一量纲下的价格，应便于并列比较。","涨跌幅描述价格变化；成交量和成交额分别表示交易数量与金额，表头中的单位不可丢失。"],"roles":["首列承担日期索引作用，虽未声明为行表头，仍应便于快速定位。","中间四列是地位相同的价格序列；涨跌幅是关联指标。","末两列是交易规模指标，其较长表头包含理解数值所需的单位。","首行为列标签，其余行为按日期排列的观测记录。"],"keep_whole":["日期、价格、带符号的百分比及带分隔符的小数值各自保持一行，避免拆散可比较的数值。","表头文字和单位应完整可见；有足够空间时优先保持在同一行。"],"may_wrap":["空间需要重新分配时，成交量和成交额的表头可在名称与括号单位之间换行，单位本身保持完整。"],"same_scale":["四个价格列内容长度和作用相近，宜采用相同或相近宽度。","成交量与成交额同属交易规模，但内容宽度不同，无须强制等宽。"],"h_vs_v":"按给出的单行测量值，列宽合计602px，加外边框后为603px，已可在607px视口内完整单行显示。因此首选紧凑单行方案；让较长表头换行可以为价格列增加空间或缩窄整表，但会增加表头高度，应有明确用途。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d1r0A, d1r0B, d1r0C.
Measured facts:
d1r0A: column widths [98, 55, 55, 55, 55, 69, 101, 114] px · table 603×167 px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers on >1 line: 0/8 · tallest cell 1 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 0 · fits the 607 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r0B: column widths [98, 58, 58, 58, 58, 69, 82, 114] px · table 596×187 px · row heights [53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers on >1 line: 1/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 0 · fits the 607 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r0C: column widths [98, 55, 55, 55, 55, 69, 101, 90] px · table 579×187 px · row heights [53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers on >1 line: 1/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 0 · fits the 607 px viewport (no scrolling)

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). This is your first look at real renders: propose at least one improved or alternative design (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or test an important idea you have not tried). "done" is not allowed yet. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d1r0A","good":"日期、数值和全部表头均完整单行显示；四个价格列等宽，便于逐行读取和纵向比较。表格正好利用视口，行距和密度均匀。","problems":"价格列较紧凑，但内容仍有清晰的单元格边界，未见实际可读性问题。","cause":"四个价格列各55px，恰好容纳34px内容及21px边距；末两列分别为101px和114px，足以保持长表头单行。"},{"design":"d1r0B","good":"价格列略宽，四列仍保持一致；成交量数值完整，表头中的单位也保持完整。","problems":"只有成交量表头换行，使整个表头增高，视觉重心偏向这一列；增加的价格列空间对本例短数值的帮助有限。","cause":"成交量列从101px缩至82px，使“成交量”与“（手）”分行；四个价格列各增至58px。"},{"design":"d1r0C","good":"日期、价格和交易量内容保持完整，表格较窄。","problems":"成交额表头的“（万元）”被拆开，单位阅读不连续；表头增高，但节省出的宽度没有用于改善其他列。","cause":"成交额列缩至90px，无法容纳完整单行表头，浏览器又在单位内部断行。"}],"best":["d1r0A"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[98,62,62,62,62,69,82,98],"change":"测试另一种有明确用途的分配：加宽四个价格列，同时收窄两个交易规模列，使长表头换行。成交额列比d1r0C加宽8px，检验能否在名称与完整单位之间换行；若单位仍被拆开，则这一方案不如d1r0A。"}]}
